ranks.message: Showing Search Console positions only. Add DATAFORSEO_LOGIN and DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD for live Google results.

gsc.message: Add the GSC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON secret to turn on Search Console data.

ai_visibility.message: Add any of OPENAI_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, PERPLEXITY_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to start tracking AI answers.

tips.message: Add the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret to turn on written recommendations.
